name: Ubiquiti UniFi
description: Reads the UniFi Network application (UniFi OS consoles such as Dream Machine, Cloud Key Gen2+, Cloud Gateway, or a self-hosted classic controller): gateway, switches and access points, which device hangs below which, which switch or access point every client is on with Wi-Fi signal and link rate, and each device's health: processor, memory, temperature, uptime, firmware (and the waiting upgrade), ports and WAN speed. Read-only: one login, a few reads and a logout per sync.
author: Netlens
supports: UniFi network (confirmed working on real hardware by the maintainer; model and firmware not recorded)
UniFi OS consoles (Dream Machine, Cloud Gateway, Cloud Key Gen2+) and the classic self-hosted controller on port 8443 are both supported by the code

releases.changelog: The health of every device from the device list the plugin already reads: processor, memory, temperature, uptime, firmware (and the waiting upgrade), ports with link, speed and counters, and the WAN connections. Needs Netlens 0.4.237.
Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Written from the public API and tested against a simulated controller only: please test it on real hardware and report back (see the README).
Adds a diagnostic report: a Run diagnostic button on the plugin's page (Netlens 0.2.67 or newer) shows an anonymised description of what the controller answers, to copy or download.
